# @arki/ts

> Helper types for object shapes, key casing and dotted paths, plus `once`, `lazyObject` and `resolveLazy`. It is not a validation or schema library.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/ts`: Helper types for object shapes, key casing and dotted paths, plus `once`, `lazyObject` and `resolveLazy`. `lazyObject`, `once`, `resolveLazy`; types `Autocomplete`, `CamelToSnake`, `DeepCamelToSnake`, `DeepPartial`, `DeepRequired`, `DeepSnakeToCamel`, `Lazy`, `Nullable`, `PathValue`; and 5 more.
- `@arki/ts/testing`: `expectImportPure`: assert that importing modules from a bare environment observes nothing. `expectImportPure`; types `ImportPurityOptions`.
- `@arki/ts/prettify`: `Prettify`: flatten an intersection so the IDE shows one resolved object type. types `Prettify`.
- `@arki/ts/utils`: Helper types for casing (`SnakeToCamel`, `CamelToSnake`), paths (`RecordToPath`, `PathValue`) and object shapes (`DeepPartial`, `Nullable`, `Without`). types `Autocomplete`, `CamelToSnake`, `DeepCamelToSnake`, `DeepPartial`, `DeepRequired`, `DeepSnakeToCamel`, `Nullable`, `PathValue`, `RecordToPath`, `Serializable`, `SnakeToCamel`, `Without`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- `RecordToPath` stops at arrays: there is no `'list.0'`.
- `CamelToSnake` drops number and symbol keys.
- Type assertions run in `bun run typecheck`, not in `bun run test`.
- `@arki/ts/testing` is Node only.
